name: Review evacuation triggers
description: Review fire, smoke, flood, road, or official-warning triggers that require leaving.
notes: Act early if mobility, pets, or dependents need extra time.

name: Pack go-bag
description: Load go-bags with water, food, medications, lights, power, clothing, cash, and documents.

name: Confirm route
description: Check primary and backup routes for smoke, flooding, road closures, bridges, or checkpoints.
notes: Share road blocked/bridge out events if useful.

name: Fuel vehicle
description: Top off fuel or EV charge and load spare transport supplies where safe.
notes: Do not wait until evacuation order if fuel access may close.

name: Gather documents
description: Collect IDs, insurance, property records, prescriptions, medical notes, and pet records.
notes: Keep waterproof pouch for flood risk.

name: Pack masks and protection
description: Pack smoke masks, eye protection, gloves, boots, waterproof gear, or other hazard-specific protection.
notes: Match gear to wildfire smoke or floodwater risk.

name: Prepare pets and dependents
description: Prepare carriers, leashes, medications, special equipment, comfort items, and extra time for loading.

name: Neighbor check
description: Check selected neighbors, elderly contacts, or mutual-aid circle members if safe and planned.
notes: Do not delay personal evacuation unnecessarily.

name: Share hazard observations
description: Send concise updates for blocked roads, floodwater, fire, smoke, unsafe areas, or checkpoints.
notes: Include time and location if safe.

name: Depart early
description: Leave before routes become unsafe, especially with dependents, pets, or limited mobility.

name: Arrival and status update
description: Confirm arrival, safety, remaining needs, and whether any group members are missing or delayed.
notes: Close open requests or add new needs.
